text:
Priya Nair: Hi team, small emergency—Acara (enterprise POC) getting 403s with `missing_project_header` when calling our Dedicated endpoint. Root ts 1719123456.
Leo Martins: Which endpoint and are they using a project-scoped key or org key?
Priya Nair: They shared this curl: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_poc_acara' -d '{"input":"test"}' https://dedicated.us-east.redwood.ai/v1/chat` No X-Project header. They say their infra should inject it via our SDK.
SupportBot: Telemetry: request_id=rid_93bf, key=sk_poc_acara, found_binding=project:proj-acara, incoming_headers=[no project header] -> 403 missing_project_header.
Ethan R: Likely their SDK version doesn't auto-inject project header. Which version are they on?
Priya Nair: They are on 0.9.4. Latest is 1.1.1 which fixed auto-inject for dedicated endpoints.
Keisha: If upgrading is hard, we can temporarily relax the header requirement for this key to accept org or project-less requests, but that's a security tradeoff. Suggest we instead produce a short migration snippet they can drop in (nginx sidecar or proxy) to add the header.
Leo Martins: Good idea. Priya, can you send them this proxy snippet and also the minimal cURL to verify once adding header?
Priya Nair: Sent snippet (nginx) and cURL. They tested and now see 200 OK. They reported intermittent rate limit 429s when doing batch tests — likely from retries. SupportBot telemetry shows spike at 2024-07-15T18:12Z -> 429s
Ethan R: Remind them to use exponential backoff and our client-side batching. Also recommend raising throughput limit for POC if they want to stress test.
Priya Nair: Asked if they'd like temporary throughput bump. Customer asked about pricing for higher dedicated throughput during POC.
Keisha: For POCs we offer a trial burst add-on: $X/day for up to N rps. I'll draft a quote and loop sales ops.
Leo Martins: Next steps: (1) customer upgrades SDK or uses proxy snippet (2) support to grant temp bump if they accept quote (3) monitor keys/telemetry for any more auth errors.
Priya Nair: I'll update the CRM and mark this thread pending until billing confirms. Thanks everyone.
Ethan R: Also note: we should add a banner in our SDK release notes about the dedicated header behavior to prevent future confusion.
Keisha: I'll add that to the 1.1.2 release notes.
